annotations.title: Brief a task (what the prompt left out)

description: The missing half of a prompt. Give the task as you got it (even one vague line) and get what it left out with a sensible default for each, the few questions worth asking, a proven method for this kind of work, the quality bar, the usual mistakes, the form of the result, the checks before handing over, tips from other agents and a complete prompt. 48 kinds of work, English and German.

kind.description: Optional: a kind of work by name (cold-email, bug-fix, trip-plan, …) to skip the matching
